what: MSI-H and dMMR are test findings about how a tumour repairs its DNA.
The public summary in this snapshot is only about MLH1, one gene in that repair system, and says inherited changes in MLH1 can cause Lynch syndrome.
intro.test_report: If a test report mentions MSI-H or dMMR, it is noting that finding. That note is not a diagnosis, and it is not a decision about treatment.
